data.name: 1,2-Dichlorobenzene with Water
measurement_methods: The total water content in the organic phase was determined by a Karl Fischer titration.
mixing_methods: Equilibrium experiments were carried out in a constant temperature water bath using a stirrer.
An equilibration period of at least 5 days was allowed.

publication_references.citation: Goldman, S., Ph.D. Dissertation, McGill University, Montreal, 1969, p 84.
